parameters.name: property_visibility
parameters.description: The property visibility to filter by.

parameters.name: unit_ids
parameters.description: Unique reference number of the unit or units to filter by.

parameters.name: property
parameters.description: The property filter. Expand to view all attributes associated with this filter. You can only submit ONE of the below filters.

parameters.name: parties_ids
parameters.description: The occupancy, owner, rental_application ids to filter by. Expand to view all attributes associated with this filter. If required, you must submit an id for at least one of the below filters.

parameters.name: assigned_user
parameters.description: Assigned user id to filter by.

parameters.name: due_at_from
parameters.description: The 'Due Date From' date to filter by.

parameters.name: due_at_to
parameters.description: The 'Due Date To' date to filter by.

parameters.name: columns
parameters.description: Returns the specified columns. All columns are returned by default. Look at the response schema to see the available columns.
